content.text: Please perform a thorough senior-developer code review of this repository. Scope: the whole workspace (src/stats.py, committed at HEAD; base revision is the initial commit, no uncommitted changes). Intended behavior: median(values) returns the statistical median of a non-empty list of numbers, and mean(values) returns the arithmetic mean. Review the code and any related tests. Review only; do not change files. Report serious or critical issues in concise plain English, with fixes and an assessment of production merge readiness. Distinguish verified findings from uncertainty and identify validation gaps. During your final answer, Rate each issue you find from 1 to 10 on how often it would happen, and 1-10 on how bad it would be

args.command: git status --short --branch && git log --oneline --decorate --all && root=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) && git diff --stat "$root"..HEAD && git diff --check "$root"..HEAD && git diff "$root"..HEAD

args.plan:
# Senior Developer Review

- Inspect the initial-commit-to-`HEAD` diff and verify the workspace is clean so findings are scoped to the requested committed revision.
- Review [`src/stats.py`](src/stats.py) for importability, correctness of odd/even median calculations, arithmetic-mean behavior, boundary cases, and numeric-type assumptions.
- Confirm whether any tests or Python project configuration exist; run non-writing syntax and focused behavior checks where importability permits.
- Deliver a concise review containing only serious or critical findings. For each issue, state whether it is verified, give an actionable fix, and rate occurrence likelihood and impact severity from 1–10. Separately identify uncertainties, validation gaps, and production merge readiness.

No files, commits, or configuration will be changed.

todos.content: Verify clean state and inspect the initial commit to HEAD diff
Review and validate stats.py syntax and required behavior
Inspect tests/configuration and identify validation gaps
Report verified serious issues, fixes, ratings, uncertainty, and merge readiness
